title: What If GTA Was Set In London? Fan Creates Stunning Map
description: As the gaming world awaits GTA6, a talented YouTuber and cartography fan has created a stunning GTA-style map of London, imagining the series in the UK.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Imagining the GTA Universe in London

While the vast majority of the gaming community is currently fixated on upcoming official news for *GTA6*, the imagination of hardcore fans and creators knows no bounds. According to a recent report by Eurogamer, a YouTuber and cartography enthusiast named CityEd has tackled a fascinating hypothetical scenario: what if London existed in the Grand Theft Auto universe, and what if Rockstar Games actually set a title there?

This unique project sits squarely at the intersection of dedicated GTA fandom and detailed map-making. While Rockstar has firmly established that *GTA6* will take players back to the sun-soaked streets of Vice City, the possibility of a modern return to a UK-based setting has long been a subject of community discussion.

## A Masterclass in GTA Cartography Style

CityEd's map successfully translates the distinct architectural layouts and geographical features of London into the iconic, recognizable cartographic style seen in the Grand Theft Auto series. From the winding path of the River Thames to the dense urban layout, the project captures the exact aesthetic that players have come to associate with Rockstar's open-world design language.

Projects like this highlight the incredible talent within the community. While it has no official connection to *GTA6* or Rockstar Games, it offers a compelling look at how one of the world's most famous capitals could look through the lens of a classic crime sandbox franchise.

## Editor's Take

This fan-made London map is a fantastic piece of community art that appeals to both cartography nerds and GTA die-hards. While we are all laser-focused on the official rollout of *GTA6*, creations like CityEd's remind us of the boundless potential of the GTA franchise's universe.
